info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to hide, to conceal,to take away,to deny

examples: 'na te saKyamapahnuve' (f॰1.130.4). apahnuve=apanayAmi=parAkaromi.
'tenAhiMsizam, iyaM sukanyA tayA te'pahnuve' (Sa॰brA॰4.1.5.7). apahnuve nizkftiM karomItyarTaH.
'yena vAhanena DAvayet tadvimucya brUyAt pAyayatEnat suhitaM kurutetyeza u vAhanasyApahnavaH' (Sa॰brA॰1.8.2.9). atrApahnavena tarpaRaM praharzaRamanunayanaM vivakzyate.
'jYAtaM mayA te hfdayaM saKe mA'pahnavaM kfTAH' (kaTA॰10.92). mA'palapIrityAha. AtmAnaM nirvedAya mA dA ityevaM kaTAsaritsAgarasyAnuvAdako'nuvadati.
'ahaM hi mAtrA janito BavAn svayaM mamAyuDaM vfttirapahnavastava' (paYca॰1.25). apahnavaH premA.
'sApahnavAH sadEvAsan pARqavAH pARqupUrvaja' (BA॰BIzma॰65.22). sApahnavAH=pracCannapApAH=apraKyAtakilbizAH.
'tatra tAvadapahnute (sati) hoturapacArAdilA nAma kanyA baBUva' (vi॰pu॰4.1.9). apahnute=viparIte saNkalpe.
'kAmadevavyapadeSena saKIpurato'pahnutaH' (ratnA॰2). kAmo'yamityuktvA svarUpApanayapuraHsaraM saKyAH puraH sanniDApita ityarTaH.
'aNgErapahnutopyanyE ryasyA divyAnukAriBiH. cakzuzA capalenokto martyaBAvo nimezataH' (kaTA0 74.216).. apahnuto gopitaH, saMvftaH.
'ko nu mA'nuSizyAdBo itIhApeva nihnute' (CAM0 u0 4.14.2). apanihnuta iva=apahnavamiva karoti.
'te nihnuvate' (Sa0 brA0 3.4.3.21). prAyaScittaM kurvantItyarTaH.
'aTa nihnute… namo vaH pitaraH SUzAyeti' (go0 gf0 4.3.17). ukto'rTaH.
'ete vE yajYamavanti ye brAhmaRAH, tadu teByo nihnute' (Sa0 brA0). tAnprasAdayatItyarTaH, tAnkzamayatIti vA.
'yajYo vE vizRustasmA evEtannihnute mA tvA'vakramizam' (Sa0 brA0 1.4.5.2). tadvyatikramaM nizkarotItyarTaH.
'namo dive namaH pfTivyA iti prastare nihnuvate' (E0 brA0 1.26). nihnavaH prastare pARyorniDAnamiti vE viduriti zaqguruSizyaH.
'pratyetya prastare nihnuvate' (kA0 SrO0 8.2.8). ukto'rTaH.
'yasya tvezAmagrataH siDyet sa nihnutamevAgnO hutvA…' (go0 gf0 1.4.25). nihnutaM tUzRIm.
'tasyEva vyaBicArasya nihnavaH samyagucyate' (manu0 9.21). nihnavaH pApApanodanaM SoDanaM prAyaScittam. anupacarito DAtvarTa ihASritaH.
'nihnave BAvito dadyAd Danam' (yAjYa0 2.11). nihnavo'palApaH.
'sUkzmatvAnna sa (DarmaH) vijYAtuM Sakyate bahunihnavaH' (BA0 SAM0 263.36). bahunihnavo bahutirohitArTaH. bahvanuktArTa iti yAvat.
'na nihnavaM mantragatasya gacCet' (BA0 u0 37.29). mantrasyApahAraM na gacCet, mantraM na dUzayedityarTaH. aviSvAse'pahnave nikftAvapi nihnava ityamaraH.
'tadvE mA tAta tapati pApaM karma mayA kftaM tadahaM nihnuve' (E0 brA0 7.17). nihnuve pariharAmi, nizkftimasya karomi.
'gArhapatyAyEva nihnute' (tE0 saM0 1.5.8.3). nihnute prahvI Bavati, CAdayati vA tvamevopasTeya iti. (BawwaBAskara). sAyaRastu nihnute'palapatItyAha.
'na devAnAmapi hnutaH sumatiM na jugukzataH' (f0 8.31.7).  apihnutaH pratyAcakzAte.
